summary: Iran launched two ballistic missiles at the United Arab Emirates, which were intercepted by UAE air defenses, prompting the UAE to halt all trade and financial transactions with Iran. Concurrently, the IDF eliminated a Hamas company commander and three platoon commanders in Beit Lahia, northern Gaza, who participated in the October 7 attacks. A ship was also targeted in the Bab al-Mandab strait off Yemen's Mokha port.
key_points: Iran fired two ballistic missiles at the UAE; UAE air defenses intercepted both missiles. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6383, @asafroz/52553)
UAE Foreign Ministry announced a complete halt to all trade, commercial exchanges, and financial transactions with Iran until further notice. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/79498, @mamlekate/104181)
IDF struck Hamas Nukhba commanders in Beit Lahia, killing a company commander and three platoon commanders involved in the October 7 massacre. (Source: @New_security8200/203356, @almogboker78/18000)
IDF struck Hamas commanders in Shati, northern Gaza, who were planning attacks against Israeli forces. (Source: @idf_telegram/24922)
A ship was targeted in the Bab al-Mandab strait off the Yemeni port of Mokha. (Source: @naya_foriraq/88148)
Artillery shelling reported in Al-Khiam and Kfar Reman in southern Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/37339, @redlinkleb/37317)

Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf visited Baghdad, meeting Iraqi officials and stating the US assassinated resistance leaders who saved the region from ISIS. (Source: @naya_foriraq/88140, @presstv/203346, @presstv/203350)
An Emirati tanker seized in the northern Hormuz corridor was diverted to Iran's Bandar Abbas port. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/79506)

points: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps fired two ballistic missiles toward the United Arab Emirates, both intercepted by UAE air defense systems; the UAE subsequently announced a full suspension of trade, commercial exchanges, and financial transactions with Iran until further notice. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6383, @asafroz/52553, @rodast_omiddana/79498, @mamlekate/104181)

Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf arrived in Baghdad for meetings with Iraqi President Nizar Amidi and Parliament Speaker, stating the US assassinated resistance leaders who saved the region from ISIS and highlighting Iran's power demonstrated in the 'Ramadan War'. (Source: @naya_foriraq/88140, @presstv/203346, @presstv/203350)

CNN reported that Iran has lost significant control over the Strait of Hormuz, with both Iran and the US claiming superiority in the area, causing confusion; simultaneously, Trump ordered a halt to nuclear talks with Iran, shifting to a strategy of gradually 'strangling' Iran economically. (Source: @mamlekate/104184, @Faytuks_Network/6385)

An Emirati-flagged tanker previously seized in the northern Hormuz corridor was diverted toward Iran's Bandar Abbas port, indicating continued Iranian naval enforcement in the strait. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/79506)
Global oil prices continued rising, touching $92 per barrel, amid heightened tensions following the Iranian missile launch and trade suspension. (Source: @naya_foriraq/88146)

IDF aircraft struck a meeting of Hamas Nukhba commanders in Beit Lahia, northern Gaza, eliminating a company commander, three platoon commanders, and additional operatives; one of the killed had infiltrated Israel during the October 7 massacre. (Source: @New_security8200/203356, @almogboker78/18000, @idf_telegram/24926)
IDF conducted a separate strike in the Shati area of northern Gaza targeting Hamas commanders planning imminent attacks against Israeli forces operating in the Strip. (Source: @idf_telegram/24922)

The IDF's Southern Brigade and Yahalom combat engineering unit sealed two additional subterranean tunnel routes in Gaza, continuing underground threat neutralization. (Source: @New_security8200/203368)

After 44 years, the remains of Sergeant First Class Yehuda Katz, missing since the 1982 Battle of Sultan Yacoub in Lebanon, were recovered and returned to Israel following a joint intelligence operation by Aman and Mossad. (Source: @manniefabian/58990, @yediotnews25/134076, @New_security8200/203359)

Defense Minister Israel Katz affirmed Israel's Gaza policy: removing threats, eliminating terrorists, and exacting a price from all who participated in the October 7 massacre, stating operations will continue with force. (Source: @almogboker78/17998)

Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir visited Israeli troops deployed in southern Syria, delivering a message to Syrian leadership and Turkish President Erdogan regarding security arrangements. (Source: @amitsegal/64028)

Israel claimed Syria nearly violated an agreed security status quo by allowing Turkish forces to deploy at an air base near Aleppo, ignoring repeated Israeli warnings; Israel said it would welcome a return to the status quo. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6385)

Hamas's military wing called for a popular uprising in the West Bank and Jerusalem, urging Palestinians to besiege settlers, attack them with knives and firearms, and make the land 'vomit out the settlers'. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/385599)

IDF eliminated four senior Hamas commanders in Beit Lahia, including a company commander and three platoon commanders, all linked to the October 7 attack. (Source: @New_security8200/203356, @almogboker78/18000)
IDF struck Hamas commanders in Shati refugee camp who were planning terrorist attacks against Israeli forces in Gaza. (Source: @idf_telegram/24922)
Yahalom and the Southern Brigade sealed two more underground tunnel shafts in Gaza, part of ongoing subterranean infrastructure degradation. (Source: @New_security8200/203368)
Israeli journalist Amit Segal published images of a small, empty facility in the Ali al-Taher heights area, which Israeli forces later found during operations. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/385603)
Artillery shelling struck the town of Al-Khiam in southern Lebanon, with details monitored via live mapping. (Source: @redlinkleb/37339)
Artillery shelling also hit Kfar Reman in southern Lebanon during early morning hours. (Source: @redlinkleb/37317)

The IDF's 1982 Battle of Sultan Yacoub missing soldier, Sgt. Yehuda Katz, had his remains recovered and returned to Israel after 44 years, closing a decades-long chapter. (Source: @manniefabian/58990, @yediotnews25/134076)

Iranian Parliament Speaker Ghalibaf held high-level talks in Baghdad with Iraqi President Nizar Amidi and Parliament Speaker, emphasizing Iraq's regional importance and condemning the US assassination of Iranian and Iraqi resistance leaders. (Source: @naya_foriraq/88140, @presstv/203346, @presstv/203350)
Israel's Chief of Staff Eyal Zamir visited Israeli forces in southern Syria, signaling continued Israeli military presence and messaging to Damascus and Ankara. (Source: @amitsegal/64028)

Israel accused Syria of nearing a violation of security understandings by permitting Turkish military deployment at an air base near Aleppo, warning it would pose a security threat. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6385)
Israeli forces discovered a small, empty facility in the Ali al-Taher heights, previously photographed by Israeli journalist Amit Segal. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/385603)

UAE air defenses intercepted two Iranian ballistic missiles; one fell outside territorial waters, the other within territorial waters, prompting full military readiness. (Source: @New_security8200/203360, @shin_persian/9009)

An Emirati tanker seized in the northern Strait of Hormuz corridor was diverted to Iran's Bandar Abbas port. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/79506)

sections.threat_assessment: The direct Iranian ballistic missile attack on the UAE marks a significant escalation in Iranian willingness to target Gulf states, moving beyond proxy warfare to state-on-state kinetic action. The UAE's immediate trade suspension signals a potential realignment of Gulf economic ties away from Iran under security pressure. Simultaneously, Israel's precision decapitation of Hamas's mid-level command in northern Gaza degrades operational capacity but may not dismantle the broader network. The Bab al-Mandab ship targeting suggests continued Houthi or Iranian-backed maritime disruption. Iran's diplomatic push in Baghdad aims to solidify the 'Resistance Axis' political front while its naval seizure of an Emirati tanker demonstrates persistent coercive control over Hormuz. The convergence of these vectors indicates a high probability of further multi-domain escalation.
sections.regional_response: The UAE has transitioned from diplomatic containment to economic warfare, severing all commercial links with Iran while placing its military on full alert. Iraq hosts Iranian leadership amid delicate balancing between Tehran and Washington, with Ghalibaf's visit reinforcing Baghdad's role as a conduit for Iranian influence. Israel maintains aggressive kinetic operations in Gaza and signaling in Syria, while Hamas attempts to ignite West Bank unrest. Gulf states face a dual shock: missile defense activation and oil price spikes. The US shift from diplomacy to 'strangulation' removes a de-escalation pathway, likely hardening Iranian resolve to demonstrate asymmetric reach.
sections.intelligence_notes: The recovery of Sgt. Katz's remains after 44 years demonstrates Israel's persistent intelligence penetration in Lebanon and Syria, likely leveraging human networks and technical collection over decades. The IDF's simultaneous strikes in Beit Lahia and Shati suggest real-time targeting cycles enabled by persistent surveillance and human intelligence. Iran's missile launch from its territory — not proxy — indicates a calculated decision to test UAE/US defenses and signal resolve. The Emirati tanker diversion to Bandar Abbas confirms IRGC naval capability to enforce seizures in the Hormuz corridor despite US naval presence. Hamas's West Bank uprising call reflects desperation to open a second front but lacks organizational infrastructure for sustained campaign.
